intent: Repair a deferred file writer that fails only when its returned callback executes

signals: failure occurs when the callback is invoked

steps: Run the focused test before editing and retain the exact traceback.
Inspect names captured or referenced by the returned closure.
Compare the setup parameter with the variable used when the callback opens the path.
Apply the smallest production-code correction and rerun the focused test.
failures: Avoid adding a new alias merely to silence the NameError when the existing parameter already represents the path.
Do not edit the regression test or broaden the refactor.
recovery: For deferred callbacks, validate that every referenced name exists in the enclosing scope and represents the original validated input.

outcome.verification: Focused path-output test writes and appends expected UTF-8 text
